[[File:IndependenceConcourse.jpg|250px|thumb|Concourse on the ''Independence'']]
A '''concourse''' is a gathering area where multiple paths or roads meet. Many [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] have consourses leading to various parts of the vessel. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] when in transit between [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] duties waited in the concourse area of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]<ref name="X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>, and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] did the same during his tours of duty on the cruisers [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']], [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], and ''Independence''.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> Similarly, the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] while in transit waited in the concourse area of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance II|''Vengeance'']].<ref name="TF">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>
